Y = int(input())
N = int(input())

minNumerator = -1
minDenominator = -1

def check(numerator, denominator):
    global minNumerator, minDenominator
    if numerator < 0:
        return
    if minNumerator == -1:
        minNumerator = numerator
        minDenominator = denominator
        return
    diffA = abs(minDenominator * X - minNumerator * Y) * denominator
    diffB = abs(denominator * X - numerator * Y) * minDenominator
    if diffA > diffB:
        minNumerator = numerator
        minDenominator = denominator
    elif diffA == diffB:
        if denominator < minDenominator or (denominator == minDenominator and numerator < minNumerator):
            minNumerator = numerator
            minDenominator = denominator

for i in range(1, N + 1):
    val = i * X // Y
    check(val - 1, i)
    check(val, i)
    check(val + 1, i)

print(f"{minNumerator}/{minDenominator}")
